X-ray System Update

Troy performed corrective maintenance on the X-ray inspection system, resolving the previously reported detection failure.

Subsequently, a functional verification of the equipment was conducted using test cards; each card was passed through the system 30 consecutive times, yielding satisfactory results with correct detection in every test performed.

Currently, 100% of the held product—which may have been affected—is undergoing re-inspection by being passed through the X-ray system once again, ensuring that all such product is properly inspected.

The product will remain under control until the re-inspection is complete and the corresponding release authorization has been obtained from QA.
